name: Tim-Hinnerk Heuer
story: Tim-Hinnerk Heuer co-authored “Current status and future directions of mobile GIS” for SIRC NZ in 2013, with David Medyckyj-Scott and fellow contributors. Otago’s repository records the paper under mobile devices, location-based services and open-source GIS.
Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Tim Heuer as an author of “Spatio-temporal web mapping of scientific data”.
An OpenStreetMap Photon post identifies Tim-Hinnerk Heuer; the GeoCart 2018 programme uses Tim Heuer for the web-mapping contribution.
